"Students who joined the school reading club had higher English test scores than students who did not (average 82 vs 74). So the reading club raises English scores."

Uphando lwabuza abafundi ngokulala kwabo emva koko lwaqokelela amanqaku abo amva nje okuvavanya. Intloko-ndaba yephephandaba ithi: "Lack of Sleep Lowers Math Scores."

x-e-h2-07.s.s2.hint.0: Zoba umcibisholo phakathi kokulala namanqaku, uze ucinge ukuba umcibisholo wecala elichasene unokwenzeka.
x-e-h2-07.s.s2.hint.1: Fumana ifaktha enye ebomini babafundi enokuchaphazela zombini ukulala namanqaku.

Headline: Library Use Doubles in Greenfield

Last year, the Greenfield Library recorded 4,000 visits in March. This March, it recorded 8,000 visits. The library director said the increase came from Book Month, a one-month event with free coffee for visitors. After the event ended, April had 4,500 visits.

x-e-h2-01.s.s2.modelNote.2: Isihloko esinamathela kwiinyaniso, sikhawulela ixesha kuMatshi.

The average number of late arrivals fell from 15 per week to 9. The principal said she will review the results in June before deciding whether to keep the new time.

x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Esi sisigwebo esinobuchule esisekelwe ebungqinweni, sibeka ecaleni isiphelo esiqinileyo kuba yidatha yeveki enye kuphela.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Yinyaniso ukuba kusele ama-80, kodwa uchaza njani ukuba inani lehle ukusuka kwi-120?
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.1.info: Iveki 2: Uhambo lwesikolo lususe abafundi abayi-100 kwabangama-400 ukusuka ngoLwesithathu ukuya ngoLwesihlanu. Amabhotile enkunkuma ngemini: 70.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.1.ask: Wolungisa njani isigwebo sakho emva kokubona ulwazi olutsha?

x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ukuba amabhotile ehle kwiveki apho kwakukho abafundi abambalwa, jonga ukuba iphulo lisona sizathu sodwa sokwehla.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Esi sigwebo siqwalasela nenye inkcazo, utshintsho kwinani labafundi.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ukuba abafundi abayi-100 abekho, amabhotile ambalwa angalahlwa nawo. Jonga ukuba oku kulolwazi onokulityeshela.

x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Esi sigwebo sijonge kuphela inyani yokuba inani alisondeli ku-0. Ulifunda njani inani kwiibhini zokuphinda zisetyenziswe?
